description:
USE WHEN you need the slug for a crypto-agent explainer before calling onchain_agent_get_wiki_page, or want to see which concepts have a sourced page you can cite.
NOT FOR reading a page (use onchain_agent_get_wiki_page instead) or finding projects (use onchain_agent_search_resources).

RETURNS (json): { total, pages: [...] }, every Onchain Agent wiki page with slug, title, keyword, summary and last_updated. Read-only.

Example: {}

response_format.description: Text format; structuredContent is JSON either way.

name: onchain_agent_list_wiki_pages
title: See what concepts are explained
